summary: Discord Core is the dimensional heart of the Realm of Discord — a place where geometry collapses, time fractures, and war-born energies churn endlessly. It is the origin point of Muramite corruption.

events: A planar collision tore open the first Discord rift.
Chaotic energies condensed into the Fracture Plains.
Shadows of fallen warriors were reanimated by Discord energy.
War-Shades became the first native defenders of Discord Core.
Weapons capable of planar invasion were created.
The Rift-Heart destabilized, creating temporal bleed.
Riftseekers attempted containment but failed to halt expansion.
